interface.name: cutefish_main_menu_manager_v1

description.summary: the menus an application shows in the status bar

interface.description:
An application's main menu is a menu whose items are the entries the status bar shows after the application's name while one of its windows is active; each entry opens the item's submenu. The submenu with the application role opens from the application's name instead of an entry of its own.
Menus and items are objects the client builds and changes at any time; every request applies at once. An item is in at most one menu, and a menu is the submenu of at most one item.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: the surface is not a toplevel

request.name: destroy

description.summary: destroy the manager

request.description: Menus, items and main menus set with it stay.

description.summary: make an empty menu

request.name: create_item

description.summary: make an item of a kind

request.description: The kind stays for the item's life.

request.name: set_main_menu

description.summary: the main menu a window shows

request.description: The menu the status bar shows while the window is active; null for none. The surface has the xdg_toplevel role, else this is the invalid_surface error. A window keeps the menu until it is set again or the menu is destroyed.

interface.name: cutefish_menu_v1

description.summary: a list of items

interface.description: Before a menu shows, the compositor sends will_open; the client brings the items up to date and answers with ready. The menu shows what it has meanwhile, and shows the changes as they arrive.

entry.name: item_in_use
entry.summary: the item is in a menu already

entry.name: invalid_index
entry.summary: the index is past the end of the menu

entry.name: not_an_item
entry.summary: the item is not in this menu

entry.name: invalid_serial
entry.summary: the serial was never sent or was already answered

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: a value is out of range

description.summary: what a submenu of a main menu is for

entry.name: application
entry.summary: the application's own menu, opened from its name

entry.name: windows
entry.summary: the menu listing the application's windows

request.name: destroy

description.summary: destroy the menu

request.description: Its items stay and are in no menu; the item it was the submenu of has none, and windows showing it as their main menu show none.

request.name: insert_item

description.summary: put an item in the menu

request.description: The item takes the place at index, the items from there on moving down; an index equal to the number of items appends it. An item in a menu already is the item_in_use error.

description.summary: take an item out of the menu
what the menu is for

request.name: ready

description.summary: the items are up to date

request.description: Answers the will_open with this serial.

description.summary: the menu is about to show
the menu is no longer shown

interface.name: cutefish_menu_item_v1

description.summary: an entry of a menu

interface.description: Enabled and shown, off, without a title, an icon or a submenu by default.

entry.name: submenu_in_use
entry.summary: the menu is the submenu of another item already, or contains the item

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: a value is out of range

entry.name: mixed
entry.summary: a dash, for a mix of on and off

request.name: destroy

description.summary: destroy the item

request.description: It leaves its menu. Its submenu stays and is the submenu of nothing.

request.name: set_title

description.summary: the entry's text

request.description: UTF-8, shown as given: an underscore is an underscore.

request.name: set_enabled

description.summary: whether the entry can be chosen

request.description: 1 by default; any value other than 0 or 1 is the invalid_value error.

request.name: set_hidden

description.summary: whether the entry is left out

request.description: 0 by default; any value other than 0 or 1 is the invalid_value error.

description.summary: the entry's check mark
an icon from the icon theme before the text

request.name: set_key_equivalent

description.summary: the key that chooses the entry, shown beside it

request.description: The key is one character, or a key named as XKB keysym names spell it, such as Return or F5; empty for none. The client handles the key itself: the compositor only shows it. Modifiers outside the enum are the invalid_value error.

request.name: set_submenu

description.summary: the menu the entry opens

request.description: Null for none. A menu that is the submenu of another item already, or one this item is in or under, is the submenu_in_use error.

event.name: activated

description.summary: the entry was chosen

event.description: Choosing an entry is user input: the serial stands for it wherever a request asks for the serial of a recent input event, such as setting the selection.
